title: Gold Rate Today, Aug 13: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices down in India | Photo Credit: FRANCIS MASCARENHAS

Gold prices in India fell today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also decreased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹14,245 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹25) and ₹1,13,960 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹200).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,245 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹25) and ₹1,13,960 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹200).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,957 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (down by ₹27) and ₹1,19,656 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (down by ₹216).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Chennai today were ₹14,200 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹50) and ₹1,13,600 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹400).

The gold prices in Delhi today were ₹15,010 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (down by ₹26) and ₹1,20,080 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (down by ₹208).
